<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Chainsaw" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Properties" name="Chainsaw properties"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Update" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Approval" name="Approval of remaining order"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_Producer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Properties" name="Send properties" sourceRef="Task_SendProperties" targetRef="StartEvent_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Update" name="Production update" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdate" targetRef="Catch_ProductionUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Catch_FirstSawReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Send approval" sourceRef="Task_SendApproval" targetRef="Catch_Approval"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Order" name="Chainsaw properties received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Order" messageRef="Msg_Properties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from online sources"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PartsArrived" name="Parts arrived">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PartsArrived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Inspect all parts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionSplit" name="Split production"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" name="Assemble first chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdate" name="Send production update to customer"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionJoin" name="Join production"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw to customer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Approval" name="Approval of remaining order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Approval" messageRef="Msg_Approval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRemaining" name="Produce remaining chainsaws"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RemainingProduced" name="Remaining chainsaws produced"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Order" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P2" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Catch_PartsArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P3" sourceRef="Catch_PartsArrived" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P4" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P5" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P6" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_SendUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P7" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P8" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P9" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin" targetRef="Task_SendFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P10" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Catch_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P11" sourceRef="Catch_Approval" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemaining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P12" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemaining" targetRef="End_RemainingProduced"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProperties" name="Send chainsaw properties"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ProductionUpdate" name="Production update received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Update" messageRef="Msg_Update"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_FirstSawReceived" name="First chainsaw received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FirstSaw" messageRef="Msg_FirstSaw"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EvaluateFirstSaw" name="Evaluate first chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Liked" name="Chainsaw liked?" default="Flow_NotLiked"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApproval" name="Send approval of remaining order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Approved" name="Remaining order approved"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotApproved" name="Remaining order not approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="Task_SendProperties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SendProperties" targetRef="Catch_ProductionUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Catch_ProductionUpdate" targetRef="Catch_FirstSawReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Catch_FirstSawReceived" targetRef="Task_EvaluateFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateFirstSaw" targetRef="Gateway_Liked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Liked" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Liked" targetRef="Task_SendApproval">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${liked}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotLiked" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Liked" targetRef="End_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_SendApproval" targetRef="End_Approved"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_Chainsaw">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_Chainsaw" bpmnElement="Collaboration_Chainsaw"/>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>
